profileLabel: Slight center-left economics (low confidence); pro-accountability institutions (low confidence)
summary: Southern Leyte 2nd District representative with 281 principal-authored bills. Authored union-organization strengthening, labor-dispute jurisdiction reform, freelance protections, a tripartite council on skills mismatch, an estate tax abolition, petroleum excise suspension, SOGIE anti-discrimination, an independent people's commission against corruption and withholding allowances for absent members of Congress.
caveat: Estate tax abolition (+2) offsets strongly pro-labor bills. SOGIE anti-discrimination is a single social issue and not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Labor: strengthening union organization, limiting labor-dispute assumption of jurisdiction and freelance protections (-2). Taxation: estate tax abolition (+2) with neutral fuel excise suspension nets +1. Two issues.
